title: Ongoing Equipment Rentals and the Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Arrangement Deposit
content:
**Memo with worked examples.** On an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account, the arrangement deposit the patient pays is settled from the figured arrangement deposit by the patient's ongoing monthly rentals.

**What counts as an ongoing rental.** Each of the patient's wheelchair line (Mobility Equipment), oxygen line (Home Oxygen Therapy) and PAP device line (PAP Therapy Equipment) that has a paid rental month whose service-from date falls fewer than 2 whole calendar months before the handling date. Each line counts once, however many paid months it shows; the count is therefore 0, 1, 2 or 3.

**Settlement.**

| Ongoing rentals | Deposit the patient pays |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | half (50 percent) of the figured deposit, rounded down to a whole dollar |
| exactly 1 | three quarters (75 percent) of the figured deposit, rounded up to the next quarter dollar — the next multiple of 0.25, 4 quarters to the dollar |
| 0 | the figured deposit as it stands, in cents |

## Worked examples (hypothetical; figured deposit 74.26)

| Ongoing rentals | Working | Deposit paid |
|---|---|---|
| wheelchair and oxygen months paid within the window | half of 74.26 is 37.13, rounded down to a whole dollar | 37.00 |
| oxygen month paid within the window only | three quarters of 74.26 is 55.695, rounded up to the next quarter dollar | 55.75 |
| none | as it stands | 74.26 |

A three-quarter figure that already falls on a quarter dollar stays as it is: three quarters of 70.00 is 52.50, and the deposit is 52.50.

**Window boundary (hypothetical).** Handling date 20 August: a paid month with a service-from date of 1 July (1 whole month before) counts; one with a service-from date of 1 June (2 whole months before) does not.
